gaps.lead: No changes will be made to this project.
gaps.hint: go ahead = proceed; according to plan
gaps.explanation: 'No changes' means the project 'will go ahead according to plan'.

gaps.lead: Although he is remarkably rich, he lives very simply.
gaps.explanation: Although he may be rich → Rich as (he) may be — fronted adjective + as + may.

gaps.lead: Most of the children ignored what the teacher had told them.
gaps.sentence: Few of the children ___ what the teacher had told them.

gaps.lead: People thought the species had died out completely.
gaps.explanation: 'People thought it had died out' becomes 'it was thought to have died out'.

gaps.lead: People believe she was the finest pianist of her generation.
gaps.sentence: She ___ the finest pianist of her generation.
gaps.explanation: A present belief about a past event: is thought to have + participle.

gaps.lead: After a year in Paris, the pace of life feels normal to her.
gaps.sentence: She ___ the pace of life in Paris.
gaps.explanation: get used to + noun/-ing = become accustomed to; present perfect for present result.
